iti17:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti17:2.1: sekhassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno appattamānasassa anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānassa viharato bāhiraṃ aṅganti karitvā na aññaṃ ekaṅgampi samanupassāmi evaṃ bahūpakāraṃ yathayidaṃ bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā.
iti17:2.2: kalyāṇamitto bhikkhave bhikkhu akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāvetīti.
iti17:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
